description: PUT a local image file to the presigned S3 URL that get_upload_url issued. Pass the `uploadHandle` from that call — it carries the destination URL, so no URL is accepted here.

contentType.description: MIME type (auto-detected from file contents if omitted)

filePath.description: Absolute path to the local image file

uploadHandle.description: The uploadHandle returned by get_upload_url. Single-use, valid 1h, and only redeemable by the caller it was issued to.

name: upload_image
